pt.titulo: Challenge or opportunity: climate policy uncertainty and green merger and acquisition
pt.resumo_biocultura: The Real Options Theory and the Growth Options Theory offer contrasting views on investment under uncertainty, with the former seeing it as a challenge and the latter as an opportunity. Using data from Chinese listed firms from 2000 to 2023, this paper documents a positive relationship between climate policy uncertainty (CPU) and firms’ green mergers and acquisitions (M&As). pt.titulo: Characteristics and simulation of ozone pollution in Haikou City under combined effects of meteorological factors and pollutants
pt.resumo_biocultura: Ozone (O3) pollution has become a central concern in regional air-quality management. Using environmental monitoring and co-located surface meteorological observations for Haikou from 2016 to 2024, we examine nine-year variations in the daily maximum 8-h average O3 concentration (O3-8 h) Twelve routinely measured air pollutants and meteorological variables were used as inputs to three models—random forest (RF), XGBoost, and LightGBM—to simulate and verify O3-8 h in 2024.
